table_description: Fact table recording quantity on hand for each item at each warehouse on each date. A simple 4-column table but at SF100TCL scale it contains approximately 12 billion rows because it captures a weekly snapshot for every item-warehouse combination across 5 years. Used for inventory analysis, stockout detection, and supply chain queries.
use_cases: Current inventory levels by warehouse or item
Item availability analysis before running promotions
data_quality_notes: INVENTORY is a periodic snapshot table — each row represents quantity on hand on a specific date, not a transaction. Do NOT sum INV_QUANTITY_ON_HAND across dates for the same item.
To find current inventory: filter on the most recent INV_DATE_SK for each item-warehouse combination.
INV_QUANTITY_ON_HAND of 0 means stockout. NULL means the measurement was not taken.
The table is indexed on (INV_DATE_SK, INV_ITEM_SK, INV_WAREHOUSE_SK) — always include all three in filters for best performance.
Join to DATE_DIM using INV_DATE_SK = D_DATE_SK.
Join to ITEM using INV_ITEM_SK = I_ITEM_SK.
Join to WAREHOUSE using INV_WAREHOUSE_SK = W_WAREHOUSE_SK.

table_columns.name: INV_DATE_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to DATE_DIM.D_DATE_SK. Date of the inventory snapshot. Part of composite primary key.

table_columns.name: INV_ITEM_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to ITEM.I_ITEM_SK. Which item. Part of composite primary key.

table_columns.name: INV_WAREHOUSE_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to WAREHOUSE.W_WAREHOUSE_SK. Which warehouse. Part of composite primary key.

table_columns.name: INV_QUANTITY_ON_HAND
table_columns.description: Units on hand at this warehouse for this item on this date. NULL means unmeasured, 0 means stockout.
